verdict.rationale: GitCafe's own features give a credible exit path. Repositories work with any Git client over HTTPS/SSH, branches can be mirrored to another Git server, and GitHub sync can run both ways, keeping code, issues and pull requests in sync on GitHub. Its REST API and CLI also return structured JSON, though that only gives building blocks for scripting your own export. There is no documented account-wide export of all data (issues, reviews, comments, settings) in an open archive format. Missing for 10: a dedicated full-account data export feature, documented export formats for non-Git data, and hands-on or independent confirmation of a complete exit.
